name: Sub-Custody Sleeve Reconstruction
description: Close the structural gap where BD sub-custody sleeve accounts (PCRA Trust, SWTC TTEE, retirement sleeves) carry $35-50M of real silver positions that never appear at gold grain because FIFO replay never receives a Transfer In.
